Overview

Santiago is a city in 25 with a population of 700,000. The Dominican Republic’s second city, an industrial and cultural hub in the fertile Cibao Valley. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
